lines.text: I thought I was fixing one edit.
Two cameras. One conversation. They refused to stay together.
Fix the timing. Lose the sound. Fix the sound. Break the render.
Then captions. Clips. New formats. Every answer opened another problem.
Some days, the only thing that finished was the error log.
Even the machines said no. But I couldn't leave it there.
Then one door opened. And the question changed.
What if the system could understand the story? Create the missing shot. Find the cut. Build the sound.
Bring it together. I didn't know I was building this.
The film you just watched was created by AutoPromote.
